worldBackgroundChinese: 缄默法则：黑暗生物约定不向人类透露黑暗社会。黑暗生物寿命长，但可活动时间短，经常沉睡，因此黑暗社会活跃度较低。

lines.speaker: Gooy
lines.text: Dear Goolie, The hot springs around Ashpine Vale have been erupting way too often lately. This old ghost really can't take the heat anymore, so I'm heading up the snow peak to cool off for a while. I'm leaving this Halloween in your hands—hang in there, little ghost!
lines.sourceChinese: 亲爱的Goolie：苍松谷最近的热泉喷发越来越频繁啦，我这个老幽灵有点受不住了，得去雪山上休息一段时间。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Wait, I only got transferred to the Ashpine Vale station a week ago! What am I supposed to do?!"
lines.sourceChinese: 这次的万圣节就交给你吧，加油吧小幽灵！

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The rookie courier ghost stares at their postman cap and lets out a helpless sigh.
lines.sourceChinese: 可是我才刚刚到苍松谷快递站一周诶，这可怎么办？

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "I've never worked a Halloween shift before! All the seniors say it's the biggest night of the year for the Shadow Society. It's the only night humans can actually see us, AND we have to strictly follow the Code of Silence so we don't blow our cover... Talk about tough! Plus, there are way too many humans wandering around town tonight—even kids running down the street in short sleeves and plastic capes... Ugh, whatever! Time to hit the road!"
lines.sourceChinese: 新人快递幽灵看了看自己的邮差帽，不由得叹气。

lines.speaker: Drow
lines.text: (Tilts her head toward Goolie, whispering) "...Thank you."
lines.sourceChinese: （歪头看向Goolie，小声）……谢谢。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "You're very welcome! Say, why is it dripping so much inside this mountain tunnel? Even the gravel under the railroad ties is pooling with water!"
lines.sourceChinese: 不客气！不过这穿山隧道里怎么滴答滴答的，连铁轨枕木底下都积水啦？

lines.speaker: Drow
lines.text: (Gently rubs her damp violin bow with her fingertips, lowering her crimson eyes) "...The rock walls keep seeping water lately. My strings got slippery... A little rosin... will fix it."
lines.sourceChinese: （用指尖轻轻蹭了蹭有些发潮的琴弓，垂下红眼睛低声说）……最近岩壁总在渗水，弦有点滑。擦了松香……就好了。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Oh, I see! Well, thank you for using Ghost Express! Hope to serve you again soon—bye now!"
lines.sourceChinese: 原来是这样，也谢谢你对幽灵快递的支持，希望以后继续选择我们，再见！

lines.speaker: Drow
lines.text: (Says nothing, simply holding out a cassette tape with both hands.)
lines.sourceChinese: （不说话，只是递过录音带。）

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Got it, got it! This must be the tape Miss Vampire asked for. The boss told me you're debuting a new song at tomorrow's party—I'm so curious! Thank you for everything you do for Ashpine Vale's night community!"
lines.sourceChinese: 好的好的，这是Vampire姐姐需要的录音带吧。听店长说，明天的party会有你的新歌，我太好奇了。

lines.speaker: Drow
lines.text: (The tips of her ears twitch slightly as she offers a shy smile.)
lines.sourceChinese: 谢谢你为苍松谷暗夜社会作出的贡献！

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "I'll leave you to your practice then. Bye, Miss Artist!"
lines.sourceChinese: （耳朵尖微微动了一下，微笑。）

lines.speaker: Wolfwoman
lines.text: "Right on time! Here's the block of rosin for our great artist, Miss Drow. Give her my best, will ya?"
lines.sourceChinese: 来得正好！这是我们的伟大艺术家，Miss Drow的松香块，请代我向她问好。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "I heard she plays the violin! Rosin is used for maintaining the bow, right?"
lines.sourceChinese: 我听说这位艺术家会拉小提琴，松香是用于养护小提琴的吧？

lines.speaker: Wolfwoman
lines.text: "Aren't you a sharp little ghost! Catch ya later!"
lines.sourceChinese: 真是位博学的小幽灵，回见！

lines.speaker: Wolfwoman
lines.text: "Oh, Goolie! That rich, fresh scent of blood—must be Miss Vampire's signature Spicy Blood Stew, huh?"
lines.sourceChinese: 哦，Goolie，这新鲜的血的气息，想必是Vampire女士的拿手好菜毛血旺吧。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Yep! Still piping hot. Ghost Express never lets you down!"
lines.sourceChinese: 是的，还是滚烫的，幽灵快递您放心！

lines.speaker: Wolfwoman
lines.text: "Awesome! I spent the whole day chasing off human brats who wandered into the woods just 'cause the weather's warm—my bones are practically falling apart. I really can't stand dealing with humans; no idea how Witch puts up with 'em. Still, getting a bite of this on a chaotic Halloween Eve instantly turns my mood around!"
lines.sourceChinese: 太棒了，今天我在林子里撵了一整天趁着天暖和乱跑的人类小孩，骨头都快散架了。我是真不爱跟人类打交道，不知道女巫怎么忍受得了。

lines.speaker: Wolfwoman
lines.text: "These jars of Ashpine autumn honey are for Little Bear. Normally this time of year, the bees only gather honeydew seeping from the pines, but lately some wild roses have been blooming out of season. Didn't feel like using 'em for honey, so I boiled 'em into jam for Grandma Jiangshi to bake flower cakes. We've got a party to throw tomorrow, after all!"
lines.sourceChinese: 这些是给小熊的灰松秋蜜，本来这个季节的蜜蜂只能找到灰松上渗出的甘露酿蜜。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Totally agree! I heard about Mrs. Jiangshi's rose pastries even before I moved to Ashpine Vale. I'd love to try one!"
lines.sourceChinese: 可是最近还有一些反季重开的玫瑰花。不过我没打算用来酿蜜，还是熬成酱交给Jiangshi老太太做鲜花饼吃吧，毕竟明天我们要开派对了。

lines.speaker: Wolfwoman
lines.text: "That old lady's got magic hands in the kitchen. Eat your fill tomorrow!"
lines.sourceChinese: 我赞同，我还没来灰松谷就听说过IJ太太的鲜花饼呢，真想试一试呀。

lines.speaker: Little Werebear
lines.text: "Hello there, little ghost. This is a light spring mead I started brewing back in April and May, aged right up until now. Could you please take it to Miss Witch for me?"
lines.sourceChinese: 你好呀小幽灵，这些是今年四五月春天就开始酿造、一直陈酿到现在的轻度蜂蜜酒，请你帮我送给女巫女士。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Hi, Little Bear! Wow, this mead looks so golden and bright—even the water droplets on the bottles are glowing!"
lines.sourceChinese: 小熊你好，这些酒看起来金灿灿的，连瓶身上的水珠都在发光呢。

lines.speaker: Little Werebear
lines.text: "Mhm! Spring honey comes from wildflowers, while autumn honey comes from pine honeydew, which looks more like deep amber. Though... usually the cellar is nice and chilly by late October, just right for storing wine. This year, I had to push all the barrels into the deepest corner just to keep them cool."
lines.sourceChinese: 对哦，春蜜一般是花蜜，而秋蜜是松树甘露蜜，会更像琥珀一些。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Thanks for your hard work! I'll deliver them safe and sound. Have fun tomorrow!"
lines.sourceChinese: 说起来，往年这时候地窖里冷飕飕的正好存酒，今年我却得把酒桶挪到最深处的墙角才行呢。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Look! Big Sis Wolfwoman sent over this autumn honey—it smells so fresh and piney! She also said it's gotten so warm that flowers are blooming out of season, and asked me to bring some flower jam to Mrs. Jiangshi."
lines.sourceChinese: 请看，这些是狼人姐姐给的秋蜜，闻起来很清新呢。她还说，现在太热了，已经有反季花盛开了，托我给Jiangshi太太送过去。

lines.speaker: Little Werebear
lines.text: (Hugs the honey jar tightly, letting out a tiny yawn before rubbing her eyes) "No wonder I've been hearing water trickling underneath the cellar floor these past few days... Even the soil feels warm."
lines.sourceChinese: （抱紧蜜罐，打了个小小的哈欠却又揉了揉眼睛）难怪这两天总听到地窖底下有淅淅沥沥的流水声，连土都是温的。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Huh? Is that gonna mess with your hibernation?"
lines.sourceChinese: 诶？那会影响你冬眠吗？

lines.speaker: Little Werebear
lines.text: "Yeah... It's definitely going to be a warm winter this year. I think I'm going to have insomnia."
lines.sourceChinese: 会呀……今年一定会有个暖冬，我可能要失眠了。

lines.speaker: Vampire
lines.text: (Pops the cassette into the deck for a quick listen, her fingers tapping the desk to the melody) "Hmm, I can feel the emotion pouring through this track. Miss Drow must have woven the sound of melting glaciers into the melody—it's so ethereal and lovely. She truly has a gift for storytelling through music; even before we met, she was recording the sights and sounds of all the places she wandered... Little ghost, our ears are in for a real treat at the party."
lines.sourceChinese: （将磁带放进机器试听，手指随着旋律轻敲桌面）我大概能领会到这首曲子的感情，Drow小姐肯定融入了冰川融水的声音。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Hooray! I can't wait!"
lines.sourceChinese: 这实在是空灵而美妙。她真的很擅长用音乐讲故事呢，在我认识她以前，她就用音乐记录过许多地方的风物……

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Miss Vampire, here's the cooling unit and the fresh livestock blood you asked Miss Witch to pick up."
lines.sourceChinese: Vampire女士，这是您托Witch女士购买的散热装置还有禽畜的新鲜血液。

lines.speaker: Vampire
lines.text: "Always so conscientious, little ghost! My old radiator suddenly overloaded and quit while I was testing the gear earlier, forcing my late-night broadcast off the air. Now I can finally get the studio back to a comfortable temperature." (She leans in and plants a gentle kiss on the little ghost's cheek.)
lines.sourceChinese: 真是尽职呢小幽灵！刚才调试设备的时候，老散热器突然过载罢工，害得我的夜间电台都停播了。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: (Instantly turns bright pink) "W-Whoa! Miss Vampire... please don't tease me!"
lines.sourceChinese: 这下又可以恢复到舒适的温度啦。（说完亲了小幽灵一口。）

lines.speaker: Vampire
lines.text: "Here you go, darling—a fresh batch of Spicy Blood Stew I just whipped up. Hurry and take it to Sister Wolfwoman before the studio cools down; she must be starving after patrolling the woods all day."
lines.sourceChinese: 喏，这是我刚刚做好的毛血旺哟，趁着播音室里还没凉下来，小幽灵快去送给狼人姐姐吃吧，她巡林肯定饿坏了。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Mission accepted!"
lines.sourceChinese: 使命必达！

lines.speaker: Immigrant Jiangshi
lines.text: (Takes the jar and gives it a sniff, her eyes crinkling into a warm smile) "Oh my? Out-of-season roses? I've lived here for over a century, and I've never seen anything like it. It keeps getting warmer and warmer... When I got up this evening for my skincare routine and looked up at the peaks, even the snowcap had shrunk..."
lines.sourceChinese: （接过罐子闻了闻，眯起眼睛笑起来）哦？反季花，我在这里生活上百年了，以前哪有这样的事哦。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Oh no, what are we gonna do?"
lines.sourceChinese: 现在越来越暖和了，我傍晚起来做保养的时候往山上看，连雪山的雪顶都变少了……

lines.speaker: Immigrant Jiangshi
lines.text: "Who knows, maybe this whole valley will flood one day... My room full of antiques certainly can't handle a soaking, and I'd hate to leave this place behind. Come, lend an old lady a hand lighting the stove—I'll bake a fresh batch of flower cakes tonight!"
lines.sourceChinese: 那可怎么办呀？

lines.speaker: Immigrant Jiangshi
lines.text: "You're such a sweetheart, little ghost—you've saved these old bones of mine! The whole reason I settled down in these museum ruins was for the leftover climate-control machines; the temperature and humidity suited me wonderfully. Alas, dampness keeps seeping up between the floor tiles lately, and the old machines just can't keep up. It's even muggier than when I crossed the ocean all those years ago! I have to slather on two extra layers of desiccant like body lotion during my daily routine!"
lines.sourceChinese: 你真是个贴心的小幽灵，拯救了我这把老骨头。我当年选择住在博物馆遗迹里，就是因为这里还有剩余的环境调节器，温度和湿度都很适合我。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Mrs. Jiangshi, will you keep living here in the future?"
lines.sourceChinese: 可惜最近地砖缝里总往外返潮气，老机器也不中用啦，简直比我以前远渡重洋的时候还潮呢，我每天做日常护理都得把防潮剂当身体乳往身上多刷两层呢！

lines.speaker: Immigrant Jiangshi
lines.text: "Hard to say, dear. Maybe I'll pack up and move further north? This endless warming certainly doesn't bode well for us."
lines.sourceChinese: IJ太太，您以后会继续住在这里吗？

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Hello, Miss Witch! Here's the mead sent over by Little Bear."
lines.sourceChinese: Witch女士您好，这是小熊送来的蜜酒。

lines.speaker: Witch
lines.text: "Just looking at this mead, I can almost see spring blossoms blanketing the woods and smell the rich aroma of wildflowers. Good wine truly is a journal of the seasons."
lines.sourceChinese: 只是看着这些蜜酒，我仿佛能看到春花开遍森林，嗅到馥郁的花草香，这些酒是季节的记事本。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Wow, Miss Witch, you talk just like a poet!"
lines.sourceChinese: Witch女士您实在是太有文化了。

lines.speaker: Witch
lines.text: (Chuckles softly) "Perhaps that's what happens when you live among humans for so long."
lines.sourceChinese: （咯咯笑）或许因为我一直和人类生活在一起吧。

lines.speaker: Witch
lines.text: "Tuck this away safely, dear—it's the moisture absorber for Mrs. Jiangshi. I heard groundwater has started seeping into her basement. I do hope she's holding up alright."
lines.sourceChinese: 收好哦，这是给IJ太太的防潮剂。听说她那里地下水渗入地下室了，希望她一切平安。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "Got it, ma'am!"
lines.sourceChinese: 好的女士。

lines.speaker: Witch
lines.text: "And here's the cooling repair kit for Miss Vampire. I truly cannot picture such an elegant lady rolling up her sleeves to fix heavy machinery... Plus some fresh livestock blood—tell her to enjoy her meal."
lines.sourceChinese: 这些是给Vampire女士的维修装置，我无法想象她这样的优雅鬼士是如何维修那些大型机械的。

lines.speaker: Goolie
lines.text: "I'm sure Big Sis Vampire will handle it without a hitch!"
lines.sourceChinese: 还有这些禽畜血，祝她吃得开心。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The human parade has finally come to an end—now, the real holiday for monsters begins. With music playing and mead flowing, though the folks of Ashpine Vale may one day part ways, right here, right now, we are together. As for tomorrow, tomorrow is another night.
lines.sourceChinese: 人类的巡游终于落幕，接下来，就是属于鬼怪们的节日了。

characterBackgrounds.description: A shy writer and part-time bard, with purple skin, white hair and red eyes. Wanders between small dark societies. She struggles with conversation, but has recorded many stories through music. Needs rosin for her violin and sends her party theme recording to Vampire.
characterBackgrounds.sourceChinese: 游走在各个暗夜小社会间的吟游诗人，不擅长沟通，但是通过音乐记录了很多故事。

characterBackgrounds.description: A warm, outgoing big sister and ranger of the foggy forest. Poses as a human by day, keeps bees, supplies rosin and shoos away lost children. Roams the wilderness and longs for freedom. She dislikes dealing with humans, and her patrols leave her hungry.
characterBackgrounds.sourceChinese: 游离在山野之中，向往自由。

characterBackgrounds.description: A sentimental young mead-maker who taught herself brewing. Has never known a human. Found a cellar after the human settlement shrank. Spring mead: primary fermentation April-May, secondary fermentation May-July, aging July-October.
A caring older sister and radio DJ, formerly a broadcaster before she was bitten. Her radiator overloads and stops the night broadcast. Cooks maoxuewang using livestock blood.

An endearingly absent-minded elderly jiangshi who crossed the ocean to Cangsong Valley a century ago. Repairs antiques in the museum ruins, uses moisture-repellent lotion and bakes Chinese flower cakes.
A maternal organizer, bar owner and bartender living among humans. Buys cooling equipment and livestock blood in the human settlement and needs mead for the party.

worldBackground: The Rule of Silence: dark creatures agree never to reveal their society to humans. They live long lives but have short active periods and spend much of their time asleep, so their society is quiet.
